answer: A staged-release escrow vault holds pay back so sybil aliases must do real work before any money moves. Each new alias locks 30 POA in the vault and its first 10 jobs pay only into it, released after 3 epochs once an orchard of 9 independent verifiers confirms the deliveries. A pearl scorecard tracks accuracy across those jobs, and the orchard re-checks 5 percent of released jobs each epoch, rerunning them from scratch to catch copied output. A failed re-check empties the vault, burns the 30 POA deposit, and bars the alias for 6 epochs, with a horizon review before it can return.
